Name: Peal of Nine Bells
Description: You create a beam of ringing sound that strikes at one creature of your choice that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet in a straight line away from you, taking 1d6 thunder damage.
At Higher Levels: This spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).
